business_summary: Jiangsu Yawei Machine Tool Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of forming machine tools, laser processing equipment, and intelligent manufacturing solutions in China and internationally. It offers sheet metal machines, such as sheet metal laser cutting machine, tube laser cutting machine, and sheet metal laser automation equipment, as well as CNC press brake, panel bender, and turret punch; stamping machines, including servo and mechanical presses, fully automatic stamping line, blanking line, slitting line, cut-to-length line and with oscillation shear, and multi-stations progressive die production line. The company also provides special laser equipment comprising 3D laser cutting machine, 3D laser welding and cladding machine, laser surface, treatment equipment, and laser micro-nano processing equipment; intelligent manufacturing services consisting of linear robot, warehouse logistics automation, digital plant planning, industrial internet platform, and industrial management software. It serves automobile, metal curtain wall, display panel, home appliance, elevator, construction machinery, steel distribution, electrical, and new energy industries. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Yangzhou, China.
